schema.description:
General-purpose request body used across reward and loyalty endpoints.
Supply at least one customer identifier: customer_mobile, customer_email, or customerId.
Not all fields are used by every endpoint — see each endpoint's description for which fields apply.

api_key.description: Merchant-level API key issued by Qubriux

customer_mobile.description: Customer's mobile number including country code

customerId.description: Your system's customer ID or Qubriux's internal customer ID

couponCode.description: Coupon code to validate and apply. Required for the applyCoupon endpoint.

recordsPerPage.description: Number of records per page. Used by getCustomerLoyaltyPointsTx.

transactionType.description: Filter loyalty transactions by type (e.g. earn, burn). Used by getCustomerLoyaltyPointsTx.

beansExpiryAfterDays.description: Show only points expiring within this many days. Used by getCustomerOffers and getCustomerLoyaltyPointsTx.

order.description:
Order context for reward evaluation. Required on validateReward, applyCoupon, and rewardRedeemed.
Optional on getCustomerOffers — when provided, enables dynamic offer eligibility against the live basket.

invoice_number.description: Invoice or receipt number for this order

order_type.description: Type of order (e.g. dine_in, takeaway, delivery, online)

gross_amount.description: Total order value before discounts and tax

net_amount.description: Total order value after discounts, before tax

tax.description: Tax amount applied to the order

loyaltyPoints.description: Number of loyalty points the customer requests to redeem against this order

source.description: Channel or platform from which the order originated

platformName.description: Name of the ordering platform (e.g. custom_app, kiosk, web)

platformVersion.description: Version string of the ordering platform

discount.description: Discount applied at the order or product level

discountId.description: Identifier of the discount rule or offer applied

discountType.description:
Type of discount. Known values: fixed_cashback, percentage_cashback,
give_away, hidden_item_offer, burn_loyalty_points

discount.title: Discount

items.description: A single line item within an order

subtotal.description: Line subtotal (rate × quantity, before item-level discounts)

quantity.description: Number of units of this modifier

subtotal.description: Total cost of this modifier (rate × quantity)
